etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From de- (“away”) +‎ bunk (“nonsense”) (from bunkum, from Buncombe County) 1923.
senses: (transitive) To discredit, or expose to ridicule the falsehood or the exaggerated claims of something; to refute.
(informal) A debunking; the act by which something is debunked.
